definitions: A German brand specializing in household cleaning products, particularly stain removers and laundry care.
A range of cleaning solutions known for tackling specific stains and maintaining fabric and appliance hygiene.
examples: She used Dr. Beckmann to remove the red wine stain from the carpet.
Dr. Beckmann offers a variety of products for different cleaning needs.
The washing machine cleaner from Dr. Beckmann is highly effective.
